uart.gap: Teensyduino `Serial` is USB1 CDC (imxrt_usb + scripted host, console on the bulk IN endpoint), not an LPUART; the Arduino matrix row teensy41 prints through it (stock Teensyduino L0/L1/L2/L5/L7), but that row needs PlatformIO and runs nightly. LPUART1-8 are imxrt_lpuart models with no firmware lane on this chip. No PR-gated lane yet.

spi.gap: No LPSPI model: LPSPI1-4 are unmapped on mimxrt1062-teensy41, so the matrix L4 cell is skipped.

i2c.gap: LPI2C1 is an imxrt_lpi2c model and the Arduino matrix row teensy41 reads an INA219 (config 0x399F, bus 0x19CA) through stock Teensyduino Wire (L3), but that row needs PlatformIO and runs nightly; no PR-gated firmware lane yet.
